semantics.off: Commits OFF/revision and key deletion atomically; no environment fallback or stale Save revival. Preserves nonsecret provider/model preferences.
semantics.alreadyAdmittedRequest: May send or finish after OFF, even if HTTP had not begun. Active counts/cap two are transient admission diagnostics, not cancellation, money ledger or restore drain.
semantics.desktopMain: Owns manifest check, secrets/enrollment, purpose keyring, safety journal and serialized startup/shutdown; guarded AI/backup/restore remain unavailable.
semantics.keyLifetime: No plaintext API key in retained React Query mutation state. No JavaScript heap/string, native or storage zeroization claim.
semantics.buildSequence: Explicit canonical signed64 nonnegative decimal string required before staging; release issuance/signing authority not verified.
